text:
incident-bot: 🚨 HIGH severity alert: GPU autoscaler failed to provision additional nodes for gpu-cluster-prod. Queue length growing, throttling observed. paging jessica (oncall) and ops-rotation (pager).

jessica (oncall): On it. I just got paged. Initial ask: are customers being rate-limited or just seeing higher latency?

elaine (support): We have multiple customer reports: slow responses and 429s on /v1/generate in us-west1. Large spike in queued requests starting ~5m ago.

nate (infra): Autoscaler logs show repeated scale requests rejected due to hitting project quota for GPU instances and then VM creation failing with driver errors on some nodes. See excerpt:
```
2024-08-02T15:12:03Z autoscaler: request_scale(+8)
2024-08-02T15:12:07Z cloud: quota_exceeded: GPUs quota (region us-west1) reached
2024-08-02T15:12:07Z cloud: create_instance failed: driver_init_error, last_log: "CUDA_ERROR_NO_GPU: Xid 79"
```

rohit (runtime): The Xid 79 suggests driver/kernel crashes on the node — could be incompatible driver+cuda combo after recent kernel patch. We also saw OOMs on some pods prior to the flaps:
```
E122 15:11:58 runtime: oom_kill: process llm_worker pid=4732 rss=18.2G
E122 15:12:07 runtime: cuda: Xid 79, GPU node down, resetting
```

maya (sre): Queue growth numbers: requests-in-queue up from 200 -> 430 in 7m. Throttling rules are starting to kick in for gold-tier customers. We should apply mitigation ASAP to protect SLOs.

jessica (oncall): Triage plan: 1) stop scheduling new jobs to problematic nodes 2) scale down risky nodes (to avoid further flaps) 3) temporarily relax autoscaler max limit to allow cross-region burst if quota permits 4) route critical customers to fallback region/model variant. I'll coordinate.

ops-rotation (pager): I can blink the scaling policy to ignore node labels that caused failures. But need infra approval if we change quota/limits.

nate (infra): Quick checks: region GPU quota at limit. We have ~10 spare GPUs across other regions in same project but autoscaler is region-scoped. I can request transient quota bump but that takes ~3-5m. Alternatively we can toggle cross-region routing in the routing layer to send new requests to eu-west1 where capacity exists.

elaine (support): Can we announce to affected customers? I can craft an interim message: "We're experiencing increased latency in us-west1; we're routing workloads to alternate regions where possible. We're working on a fix." Who should own external comms?

jessica (oncall): Elaine, please post the interim note to the status page and respond to top 5 enterprise customers. I'll own escalation with infra/team leads.

rohit (runtime): Mitigations I can perform now: 1) set runtime POD eviction threshold to reduce memory pressure (avoid OOMs) 2) restart driver daemons on flapped nodes (but they might not come back stable) 3) apply a temporary patch to retry driver init with different kernel flags. I need a go from infra to cordon/drain nodes.

nate (infra): Go ahead and cordon the 3 nodes with repeated Xid errors: gpu-node-13, gpu-node-14, gpu-node-21. I'll hold new VM creations to see if quota bump happens.

rohit (runtime): cordon/drain in progress. Draining will reschedule in-flight sessions — prefer to fail fast and let frontend retry to avoid long tail. Setting evictionPolicy=immediate for draining pods.

maya (sre): Doing routing change: enabling cross-region fallback for gold/platinum traffic only. This should reduce pressure on us-west1 by ~40%. I am also raising throttle thresholds for free/tiered customers to prevent total meltdown.

incident-bot: note: automation triggered failover to eu-west1 for route /v1/generate for customer tier=gold at 15:18:02Z.

elaine (support): Update: enterprise customer Acme reported degraded responses but are now seeing requests served from eu-west1. They're asking if data residency is affected.

jessica (oncall): Tell Acme their data is processed in an alternate region temporarily under our incident mitigation; we will post a formal RCA. Notify privacy/compliance if they escalate.

nate (infra): Quota bump approved by cloud admin — temporary +12 GPUs in us-west1; provisioning started. Some instance creations are still failing due to driver init error on image v2.1. Rolling back to v2.0 image for new nodes to avoid the driver/kernel mismatch.

rohit (runtime): Good call. v2.1 includes a kernel upgrade that shows incompatibility with current NVIDIA driver. I'm triggering image override for new instances to use v2.0. Also pushing a hotfix to runtime init: if cuda init fails with Xid 79, try fallback init path and mark node for manual inspection rather than recycling immediately.

maya (sre): Queue length dropping: 430 -> 120 over 9m after routing + quota bump + cordon. Latency for gold now within 1.3x SLO. Free-tier still seeing intermittent 429s.

jessica (oncall): Customer impact summary for incident channel: - Affected region: us-west1 - Impact: increased latency and throttling (429) for some customers between 15:11-15:27 UTC - Mitigations: cordoned 3 flapping nodes; routed gold traffic to eu-west1; temporary quota bump + image rollback for new nodes; runtime fallback for driver init - Current status: degraded -> recovering, queue draining, monitoring for further Xid events.

ops-rotation (pager): One more risk: if driver init fallback masks deeper hardware faults we'll accumulate corrupted GPU state later. Recommend manual inspection of cordoned nodes by hardware team overnight.

rohit (runtime): Agreed. I'll capture dmesg + nvidia-smi logs and share in a follow-up thread. For now we should keep cordoned nodes offline and mark as DO NOT AUTO-REJOIN until validated.

elaine (support): I'll follow up with impacted customers with a short post-incident note: "We've routed traffic and are recovering. We'll provide an RCA when available."

maya (sre): Creating incident ticket: INC-2024-8143 with all mitigation steps and timeline. Assigning to nate and rohit for postmortem.

jessica (oncall): Handing to oncall-next for the overnight window. @ops-rotation please confirm you have the pager. I'll drop detailed notes into the incident ticket.

ops-rotation (pager): Confirmed handoff. Pager with escalation to nate if Xid events reappear.

incident-bot: 📌 Incident status changed to 'mitigated' at 15:31:40Z. Ticket INC-2024-8143 created.

nate (infra): Postmortem action items I'll own: - evaluate why autoscaler didn't fall back to region-level burst - improve preflight check for new images to detect driver/kernel mismatch - coordinate quota monitoring alerts

rohit (runtime): Postmortem action items I'll own: - add safer driver init path and more conservative memory thresholds - add automated collection of dmesg + GPU logs on Xid events - test image v2.1 in staging with latest kernel/driver combo

maya (sre): I'll follow up with a runbook update for Xid 79 scenarios and adjust runbook to prefer cross-region routing before quota bumps.

elaine (support): I'll prepare a customer-facing timeline to post after the RCA.

jessica (oncall): Thanks team. Leaving notes in the ticket. If anything flares overnight please page nate first. Closing thread in #incidents for now.

incident-bot: thread archived by jessica (oncall).
